chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who arrives performing 'Umrah of Rajab, and the crescent of Sha'ban appears for him before the time (of entering 'Umrah state). Should he enter the state of Ihram before the time and designate it for Rajab, or should he delay the Ihram until the actual time (of the crescent) and designate it for Sha'ban? He (peace be upon him) said: He enters Ihram before the time, so it remains for Rajab, because Rajab has its merit, and it is the one he intended.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for 'Umrah if the new moon of Sha'ban appears while still in Rajab?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in *Al-Kafi* clarifies the precedence of intention (*niyyah*) and the specific merit of the month over the physical sighting of the crescent, a key principle in Shia jurisprudence for determining the validity of acts of worship. It highlights the flexibility within the *Umrah of Rajab* tradition, allowing pilgrims to maintain the spiritual status of Rajab even if the lunar transition occurs during their journey, thereby emphasizing the internal state of devotion over rigid chronological markers.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked himasws about the man who comes for Umra, the Umra of Rajab. So the crescent of Shaban enters upon him before he reaches the juncture. Can he wear Ihraam before the juncture, and make it to be for Rajab, or should he delay wearing the Ihraam up to the juncture and make it to be for Shaban?’ Heasws said: ‘He can wear Ihraam before the juncture, so it would happen to be for Rajab, because for Rajab there is its merit, and it is which he intended’.
en.sarwar: 9. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who travels for al-‘Umrah in the month of Rajab. It becomes the month of al-Sha‘ban before his reaching the Miqat (place for assuming the state of Ihram); should he assume the state of Ihram before Miqat, to make it al-‘Umrah of Rajab, or delay it until his reaching al-‘Aqiq and make it al-‘Umrah of the month of al-Sha‘ban? He (the Imam) said, ‘He can assume the state of Ihram, before Miqat, for al-‘Umrah of Rajab because Rajab has its virtue and that is what he had intended.’”
